web_fixture.content:
# Caldermere Fields - booking FAQ

Q: Do serviced pitches have a minimum stay?
A: Serviced pitches with electric hook-up carry a minimum stay of 3 nights
in high season. Off-peak there is no minimum.

Q: What time can we arrive?
A: Pitches are ready from 13:00, and the barrier code is sent the evening
before arrival.

Q: Are fires allowed?
A: Only in the raised fire pits at the top field.

web_fixture.title: How strict is Caldermere's minimum stay? (2024 thread)
web_fixture.snippet: In 2024 the serviced pitches had a 2-night minimum over weekends.
web_fixture.content:
wildcampreviews.example - England - Caldermere minimum stay?

p1 (pitchwalker, 2024-06-02): Weekend stays on the serviced pitches
needed 2 nights minimum back in 2024, the desk would not take a
one-night booking.

p2 (fenrambler, 2024-06-04): Same for us that spring. No idea what the
current card says.
